title: Coast Guard Surf Life OBX
description:
Coast Guard 47-foot Motor Lifeboat crewmembers and operators train on North Carolina’s Outer Banks during January 2016.

Surfmen and their crews operate in some of the harshest maritime environments the world has to offer.

U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Nate Littlejohn, Station Oregon Inlet and Capt. Joseph Dufresne
